_doc: Quests (docs/GAME_DESIGN.md#quests). Each stage has a goal: talk (npc), kill (tag or enemy id, count), item (picked up), flag (Game flag set). reward on a stage is given when that stage completes. next starts another quest when this one ends.

stages.text: Speak with old Klothia at her loom in Elaion.
Sever the Unthreaded in the olive terraces
Climb the cypress road to the necropolis and destroy Captain Lykos.
Take the Seal of the Sanctuary to the gate above the necropolis.
Destroy Khalkotauros in the Sanctuary of the Moirai.
Claim the First Blade of Atropos.
